title: Reckoner hero
description: A window-tall merlot band with full-bleed background artwork, a huge two-line medium-weight title (110px desktop, 48px phones) at the left, centred in the space above a bottom row of two square buttons and a looping scroll cue; a faint vertical label runs down the right edge on desktop. Buttons fill with linen over half a second on hover.
notes: sized by the window (h-svh); reckoner-header floats over it
media fills the band like object-fit: cover; empty, it's a soft glow placeholder
CSS only; the scroll cue's loop is off under reduced motion
